title: Ginger and Turmeric Frozen Yoghurt
changes_from_base: Ground turmeric and fresh and ground ginger are steeped in the warm gelatine whey, turning the frozen yoghurt golden.
summary: A warming golden frozen yoghurt infused with ginger and turmeric. The exotic spices create a sophisticated, earthy flavour.
equipment: colander or sieve lined with three layers of muslin

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Drain
steps.text: Drain the 900 g yoghurt in a colander lined with three layers of muslin, covered in the fridge for 8-12 h until 300 ml whey has drained.

steps.title: Whey
steps.text: Discard 180 ml whey from the drained liquid. Sprinkle 1 tsp gelatine over the remaining 120 ml whey, stand for 5 min, then microwave for about 30 s until bubbling at the edges and dissolved.

steps.title: Infuse
steps.text: Stir 1½ tsp finely grated fresh ginger, 1 tsp ground ginger and 1 tsp ground turmeric into the warm gelatine, cool for 5 min, then strain through a fine sieve, pressing the solids.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk 150 g caster sugar, 3 tbsp golden syrup, ⅛ tsp fine salt, the drained yoghurt and the spiced whey until the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Chill in the fridge or over an ice bath for about 3 h to 4 °C or below.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn in the ice-cream maker for about 20 min to thick soft-serve.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Freeze in an airtight container for about 2 h; keeps for 5 days.

tips: Use a plastic or steel bowl for preparation, as turmeric stains ceramic and wood.
Strain the spiced whey thoroughly to remove any solids and create a smooth, silky texture.
Chill for at least 3 h before churning to ensure proper freezing.
storage: Store in an airtight container in the freezer for up to 5 days.
